summary: Learn AWS service selection, IAM, VPC basics and cost estimation through practical workload exercises. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: AWS fundamentals helps IT support analysts, application coordinators, and cloud service owners make initial service choices for small workloads. Learners map workload responsibilities, set out IAM access boundaries, and compare compute and storage options using familiar application scenarios. They also practise estimating costs with AWS Pricing Calculator and communicating assumptions and open issues for operational handoffs.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who support, coordinate, or review small AWS workloads and need to make sense of service choices without taking on cloud engineering responsibilities.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace IT systems is useful. AWS experience and programming are not required. Bring a laptop with a web browser for the AWS Pricing Calculator exercise; no software installation or AWS account is required for that exercise.
